output.level_0: The canary store's forecast crashes, corrupting the order suggestion before anyone notices the outage.
output.level_1: No canary exists, so a bad model update hits all stores simultaneously during the morning order window.
output.level_2: A buyer manually picks one store to test a new forecast version and watches the results in a spreadsheet.
output.level_3: The system automatically routes a small store group to the new model and compares its availability metrics.
output.level_4: Governed canary tests enforce statistical significance and compliance checks before any model version reaches full scale.
